title: Lorenz attractor and Lyapunov exponent
subject: Nonlinear dynamics
assumptions: Lyapunov exponent estimated by two trajectories separated by 1e-8

tasks.prompt: Integrate the Lorenz system, plot the x-y projection, and estimate the largest Lyapunov exponent.

checks.description: Largest Lorenz exponent is about 0.9 for these parameters.
